propositions: Markdown-aware encode via marklas.to_adf must emit structured ADF nodes (heading, list, codeBlock, marks) rather than literal syntax characters in plain paragraphs
Decode via marklas.to_md must return source Markdown from ADF, with mark-order canonicalization to break the **~~x~~** ⇄ ~~**x**~~ 2-cycle oscillation
HTML comments present in source Markdown must survive round-trip encode→decode, falling back to plain text_to_adf if the engine would drop them

Three functions (markdown_to_adf, adf_to_markdown, fit_markdown_to_adf_limit) must lazy-import marklas inside function bodies and degrade to plain adf.py fallback on ImportError, preserving stdlib-only engine contract
marklas and mistune must ship as pinned optional extra (0.8.6 and 3.3.4 exactly) rather than vendored source, mirroring agents/metrics/grounding precedents
Over committed 360-body corpus fixture, MD→ADF→MD round-trip must reach fixed point ≥99.6% of bodies with ≥15% structurally rich (block nodes), zero conversion errors, zero unscrubbed secrets
